ING-007-street-bookstore-door.why: Single central Kelly plate with lock, staples left/right, braided top edge, heavy glossy creasing; storefront light reads iPhone-real, face out of frame. v1 closure reads off-center with odd flap fold, v3 leather flatter.

ING-008-street-market-stall.why: Clean staple-plate-staple layout with ring turn lock, braided edge, hero-grade creasing, believable market light, hands natural. v1 clasp reads as a plain rectangle without the lock, v2 hardware sits misplaced high on the flap like invented extras.

ING-012-street-dogwalk.why: Bag front-on in foreground shows one belt, two staples, one central plate exactly per gallery; golden-hour grain photoreal, face away. v1/v2 pass but bag too small to verify closure and less prominent.

ING-014-street-crisp-morning.why: Clearest correct closure (staple-plate-staple, single gold plate), heavy antiqued creasing, braided edge, winter street light believable, face hidden by hair/angle. v2 correct but bag small in frame, v1 hardware too soft to confirm.

ING-020-cafe-marble-table.why: Single central plate with turned lock, staples both sides, deep burnished creasing closest to hero, rainy-window cafe grain very photoreal, napkin unreadable. v3 shows a second gold plate beside the clasp (double-plate fail pattern) plus a printed receipt; v2 passes but v1 is truer and more prominent.

ING-024-cafe-croissant-morning.why: Both handles visible, correct single-plate closure with staples, braided top edge, blown-highlight sunlight and crumbs read real. v3 front-on hides the second handle and crops the top, v1 slumps and closure less legible.

ING-026-cafe-bakery-counter.why: Ring turn lock on one central plate clearly visible, staples, double-row braided edge, hero-match gloss creasing, natural hand with ring, no readable bakery text. v1 and v3 pass truth but are softer on closure detail.

ING-030-cafe-diner-booth.why: Correct single-plate closure with diagonal lock, staples, braid, raking window light on cracked booth leather is very photoreal, no readable text. v2 has a prominent menu with visible printed text lines, v3 passes but v1 composition is stronger.

ING-032-car-console-latte.why: Staple-plate-staple layout with belt end hanging naturally, braided edge, heavy glossy creases matching hero, unbranded latte cup, parking-lot light reads phone-shot. v2 leather turns painterly/smooth in the lower body, v1 passes but v3 is truer to the hero patina.
